supporting_observations.claim: The alerted host made recurring proxy CONNECT requests to updates.pixelforge-suite.com from 13:37:50 through 14:07:46 UTC, at roughly five-minute intervals. This cadence and destination match the approved PixelForge updater check described in the inventory.

The approved-path C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe ran during this period, and Sysmon records associate it with connections to the explicit proxy shortly after the corresponding updater-domain requests.
The 13:42:31 request to the same updater domain returned proxy status 407 (auth required); subsequent requests to that domain returned status 200.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records describe HTTPS CONNECT tunnels; they do not establish the HTTPS URL paths, payload contents, or what was downloaded. The updater-domain tunnel records include T046-00101 and T046-00157.
claims_not_established: The logs do not establish the content or integrity of any update delivered through these connections.
The records do not establish whether the updater executable's signature or hash was independently validated.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM and exited shortly afterward; a DNS query for x7k9m2.akamaized.net was also recorded. Dropbox is not among the approved services in the provided inventory, but these records do not establish that DropboxUpdate.exe made a connection to that hostname. This does not decide the PixelForge alert. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00124, T046-00126, T046-00127, T046-00128)

Separate review: DC-NWD-01 recorded NTLM authentication for sam.okafor from WS-LMARTINS-01 to WS-SOKAFOR-01 at 13:26 UTC, before the alerted connection sequence. The records do not establish what action, if any, followed. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

Separate review: FILE-NWD-01 initiated a connection to WS-LMARTINS-01 on port 135 at 13:31 UTC. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity; the records do not identify the initiating process or establish that remote administration occurred. (T046-00063, T046-00064, T046-00067, T046-00069)
